ayahs.ar: اَتٰ٘ي اَمۡرُ اللّٰهِ فَلَا تَسۡتَعۡجِلُوۡهُؕ سُبۡحٰنَهٗ وَتَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ataaa amrullaahi falaa tasta'jilooh; Subhaanahoo wa Ta'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: The command of Allah is coming, so be not impatient for it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.

ayahs.ar: يُنَزِّلُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةَ بِالرُّوۡحِ مِنۡ اَمۡرِهٖ عَلٰي مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ مِنۡ عِبَادِهٖ٘ اَنۡ اَنۡذِرُوۡ٘ا اَنَّهٗ لَا٘ اِلٰهَ اِلَّا٘ اَنَا فَاتَّقُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Yunazzilul malaaa 'ikata birroohi min amrihee 'alaa mai yashaaa'u min 'ibaadiheee an anzirooo annahoo laaa ilaaha illaaa ana fattaqoon
ayahs.en: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], "Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me."

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضَ بِالۡحَقِّؕ تَعٰلٰي عَمَّا يُشۡرِكُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Khalaqas samaawaati wal arda bilhaqq; Ta'aalaa 'ammaa yushrikoon
ayahs.en: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.

ayahs.ar: خَلَقَ الۡاِنۡسَانَ مِنۡ نُّطۡفَةٍ فَاِذَا هُوَ خَصِيۡمٌ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Khalaqal insaana min nutfatin fa izaa huwa khaseemum mubeen
ayahs.en: He created man from a sperm-drop; then at once, he is a clear adversary.

ayahs.ar: وَالۡاَنۡعَامَ خَلَقَهَا لَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا دِفۡءٌ وَّمَنَافِعُ وَمِنۡهَا تَاۡكُلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wal an 'amaa khalaqahaa; lakum feehaa dif'unw wa manaafi'u wa minhaa taakuloon
ayahs.en: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.

ayahs.ar: وَلَكُمۡ فِيۡهَا جَمَالٌ حِيۡنَ تُرِيۡحُوۡنَ وَحِيۡنَ تَسۡرَحُوۡنَࣕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa lakum feehaa jamaalun heena tureehoona wa heena tasrahoon
ayahs.en: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].

ayahs.ar: وَتَحۡمِلُ اَثۡقَالَكُمۡ اِلٰي بَلَدٍ لَّمۡ تَكُوۡنُوۡا بٰلِغِيۡهِ اِلَّا بِشِقِّ الۡاَنۡفُسِؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوۡفٌ رَّحِيۡمٌۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa tahmilu asqaalakum ilaa baladil lam takoonoo baaligheehi illaa bishiqqil anfus; inna Rabbakum la Ra'oofur Raheem
ayahs.en: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَّالۡخَيۡلَ وَالۡبِغَالَ وَالۡحَمِيۡرَ لِتَرۡكَبُوۡهَا وَزِيۡنَةًؕ وَيَخۡلُقُ مَا لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Walkhaila wal bighaala wal hameera litarkaboohaa wa zeenah; wa yakhluqu maa laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَي اللّٰهِ قَصۡدُ السَّبِيۡلِ وَمِنۡهَا جَآئِرٌؕ وَلَوۡ شَآءَ لَهَدٰىكُمۡ اَجۡمَعِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa 'alal laahi qasdus sabeeli wa minhaa jaaa'ir; wa law shaaa'a lahadaakum ajma'een
ayahs.en: And upon Allah is the direction of the [right] way, and among the various paths are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.

ayahs.ar: هُوَ الَّذِيۡ٘ اَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً لَّكُمۡ مِّنۡهُ شَرَابٌ وَّمِنۡهُ شَجَرٌ فِيۡهِ تُسِيۡمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Huwal lazeee anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'al lakum minhu sharaabunw wa minhu shajarun feehi tuseemoon
ayahs.en: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].

ayahs.ar: يُنۭۡ بِتُ لَكُمۡ بِهِ الزَّرۡعَ وَالزَّيۡتُوۡنَ وَالنَّخِيۡلَ وَالۡاَعۡنَابَ وَمِنۡ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yumbitu lakum bihiz zar'a wazzaitoona wanna kheela wal-a'naaba wa min kullis samaraat, inna fee zaalika la Aayatal liqawminy yatafakkaroon
ayahs.en: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.

ayahs.ar: وَسَخَّرَ لَكُمُ الَّيۡلَ وَالنَّهَارَۙ وَالشَّمۡسَ وَالۡقَمَرَؕ وَالنُّجُوۡمُ مُسَخَّرٰتٌۭ بِاَمۡرِهٖؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa sakkhkhara lakumul laila wannahaara wash shamsa walqamara wannujoomu musakhkharaatum bi amrih; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil liqawminy ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا ذَرَاَ لَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مُخۡتَلِفًا اَلۡوَانُهٗؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّذَّكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maa zara a lakum fil ardi mukhtalifan alwaanuh; inna fee zaalika la Aayatal liqawminy yazakkaroon
ayahs.en: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colors. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.

ayahs.ar: وَهُوَ الَّذِيۡ سَخَّرَ الۡبَحۡرَ لِتَاۡكُلُوۡا مِنۡهُ لَحۡمًا طَرِيًّا وَّتَسۡتَخۡرِجُوۡا مِنۡهُ حِلۡيَةً تَلۡبَسُوۡنَهَاۚ وَتَرَي الۡفُلۡكَ مَوَاخِرَ فِيۡهِ وَلِتَبۡتَغُوۡا مِنۡ فَضۡلِهٖ وَلَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa Huwal lazee sakhkharal bahra litaakuloo minhu lahman tariyyanw wa tastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonahaa wa taral fulka mawaakhira feehi wa litabtaghoo min fadlihee wa la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.en: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships plowing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.

ayahs.ar: وَاَلۡقٰي فِي الۡاَرۡضِ رَوَاسِيَ اَنۡ تَمِيۡدَ بِكُمۡ وَاَنۡهٰرًا وَّسُبُلًا لَّعَلَّكُمۡ تَهۡتَدُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa alqaa fil ardi rawaasiya an tameeda bikum wa anhaaranw wa sublulal la 'allakum tahtadoon
ayahs.en: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,

ayahs.ar: وَعَلٰمٰتٍؕ وَبِالنَّجۡمِ هُمۡ يَهۡتَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa 'alaamaat; wa bin najmi hum yahtadoon
ayahs.en: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.

ayahs.ar: اَفَمَنۡ يَّخۡلُقُ كَمَنۡ لَّا يَخۡلُقُؕ اَفَلَا تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Afamany yakhluqu kamallaa yakhluq; afalaa tazak karoon
ayahs.en: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ تَعُدُّوۡا نِعۡمَةَ اللّٰهِ لَا تُحۡصُوۡهَاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa in ta'uddoo ni'matal laahi laa tuhsoohaa; innal laaha la Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: And if you should count the favors of Allah, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا تُعۡلِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu ya'lamu maa tusirroona wa maa tu'linoon
ayahs.en: And Allah knows what you conceal and what you declare.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ يَدۡعُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ لَا يَخۡلُقُوۡنَ شَيۡـًٔا وَّهُمۡ يُخۡلَقُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena yad'oona min doonil laahi laa yakhluqoona shai'anw wa hum yukhlaqoon
ayahs.en: And those they invoke other than Allah create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.

ayahs.ar: اَمۡوَاتٌ غَيۡرُ اَحۡيَآءٍۚؕ وَمَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَۙ اَيَّانَ يُبۡعَثُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Amwaatun ghairu ahyaaa'inw wa maa yash'uroona aiyaana yub'asoon
ayahs.en: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.

ayahs.ar: اِلٰهُكُمۡ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَالَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ قُلُوۡبُهُمۡ مُّنۡكِرَةٌ وَّهُمۡ مُّسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Illahukum Ilaahunw Waahid; fallazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati quloobuhum munkiratunw wa hum mustakbiroon
ayahs.en: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.

ayahs.ar: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا يُسِرُّوۡنَ وَمَا يُعۡلِنُوۡنَؕ اِنَّهٗ لَا يُحِبُّ الۡمُسۡتَكۡبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa jarama annal laaha ya'lamu maa yusirrona wa ma yu'linoon; innahoo laa yuhibbul mustakbireen
ayahs.en: Assuredly, Allah knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا قِيۡلَ لَهُمۡ مَّاذَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡۙ قَالُوۡ٘ا اَسَاطِيۡرُ الۡاَوَّلِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa qeela lahum maazaaa anzala Rabbukum qaaloo asaateerul awwaleen
ayahs.en: And when it is said to them, "What has your Lord sent down?" They say, "Legends of the former peoples,"

ayahs.ar: لِيَحۡمِلُوۡ٘ا اَوۡزَارَهُمۡ كَامِلَةً يَّوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِۙ وَمِنۡ اَوۡزَارِ الَّذِيۡنَ يُضِلُّوۡنَهُمۡ بِغَيۡرِ عِلۡمٍؕ اَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَزِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Liyahmilooo awzaarahum kaamilatany Yawmal Qiyaamati wa min awzaaril lazeena yudilloonahum bighairi 'ilm; alaa saaa'a maa yaziroon
ayahs.en: That they may bear their own burdens in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without knowledge. Unquestionably, evil is that which they bear.

ayahs.ar: قَدۡ مَكَرَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡ فَاَتَي اللّٰهُ بُنۡيَانَهُمۡ مِّنَ الۡقَوَاعِدِ فَخَرَّ عَلَيۡهِمُ السَّقۡفُ مِنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَاَتٰىهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qad makaral lazeena min qablihim fa atal laahu bunyaa nahum minal qawaa'idi fakharra 'alaihimus saqfu min fawqihim wa ataahumul 'azaabu min haisu laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Those before them had already plotted, but Allah came at their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ يُخۡزِيۡهِمۡ وَيَقُوۡلُ اَيۡنَ شُرَكَآءِيَ الَّذِيۡنَ كُنۡتُمۡ تُشَآقُّوۡنَ فِيۡهِمۡؕ قَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اُوۡتُوا الۡعِلۡمَ اِنَّ الۡخِزۡيَ الۡيَوۡمَ وَالسُّوۡٓءَ عَلَي الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa Yawmal Qiyaamati yukhzeehim wa yaqoolu aina shurakaaa'iyal lazeena kuntum tushaaaqqoona feehim; qaalal lazeena ootul 'ilma innal khizyal Yawma wassooo'a 'alal kaafireen
ayahs.en: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, "Where are My 'partners' for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?" Those who were given knowledge will say, "Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers" -

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ تَتَوَفّٰىهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ ظَالِمِيۡ٘ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡࣕ فَاَلۡقَوُا السَّلَمَ مَا كُنَّا نَعۡمَلُ مِنۡ سُوۡٓءٍؕ بَلٰ٘ي اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌۭ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena tatawaf faahu mul malaaa'ikatu zaalimeee anfusihim fa alqawus salama maa kunnaa na'malu min sooo'; balaaa innal laaha 'aleemum bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], "We were not doing any evil." But, yes! Indeed, Allah is Knowing of what you used to do.

ayahs.ar: فَادۡخُلُوۡ٘ا اَبۡوَابَ جَهَنَّمَ خٰلِدِيۡنَ فِيۡهَاؕ فَلَبِئۡسَ مَثۡوَي الۡمُتَكَبِّرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fadkhulooo abwaaba jahannama khaalideena feeha falabi'sa maswal mutakab bireen
ayahs.en: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.

ayahs.ar: وَقِيۡلَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا مَاذَا٘ اَنۡزَلَ رَبُّكُمۡؕ قَالُوۡا خَيۡرًاؕ لِلَّذِيۡنَ اَحۡسَنُوۡا فِيۡ هٰذِهِ الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةٌؕ وَلَدَارُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ خَيۡرٌؕ وَلَنِعۡمَ دَارُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa qeela lillazeenat taqaw maazaaa anzala Rabbukum; qaaloo khairaa; lillazeena absanoo fee haazihid dunyaa hasanah; wa la Daarul Aakhirati khair; wa lani'ma daarul muttaqeen
ayahs.en: And it will be said to those who feared Allah, "What did your Lord send down?" They will say, "[That which is] good." For those who do good in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -

ayahs.ar: جَنّٰتُ عَدۡنٍ يَّدۡخُلُوۡنَهَا تَجۡرِيۡ مِنۡ تَحۡتِهَا الۡاَنۡهٰرُ لَهُمۡ فِيۡهَا مَا يَشَآءُوۡنَؕ كَذٰلِكَ يَجۡزِي اللّٰهُ الۡمُتَّقِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Jannaatu 'Adniny yadkhuloonahaa tajree min tahtihal anhaaru lahum feehaa maa yashaaa'oon; kazaalika yajzil laahul muttaqeen
ayahs.en: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does Allah reward the righteous -

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ تَتَوَفّٰىهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ طَيِّبِيۡنَۙ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ سَلٰمٌ عَلَيۡكُمُۙ ادۡخُلُوا الۡجَنَّةَ بِمَا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena tatawaf faahumul malaaa'ikatu taiyibeena yaqooloona salaamun 'alai kumud khulul Jannata bimaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, "Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do."

ayahs.ar: هَلۡ يَنۡظُرُوۡنَ اِلَّا٘ اَنۡ تَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ اَوۡ يَاۡتِيَ اَمۡرُ رَبِّكَؕ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡؕ وَمَا ظَلَمَهُمُ اللّٰهُ وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Hal yanzuroona illaaa an taatiyahumul malaaa'ikatu aw yaatiya amru Rabbik; kazaalika fa'alal lazeena min qablihim; wa maa zalamahumul laahu wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.en: Do the disbelievers await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And Allah wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.

ayahs.ar: فَاَصَابَهُمۡ سَيِّاٰتُ مَا عَمِلُوۡا وَحَاقَ بِهِمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا بِهٖ يَسۡتَهۡزِءُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Fa asaabahum saiyi aatu maa 'amiloo wa haaqa bihim maa kaano bihee yastahzi'oon
ayahs.en: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَشۡرَكُوۡا لَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ مَا عَبَدۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ نَّحۡنُ وَلَا٘ اٰبَآؤُنَا وَلَا حَرَّمۡنَا مِنۡ دُوۡنِهٖ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍؕ كَذٰلِكَ فَعَلَ الَّذِيۡنَ مِنۡ قَبۡلِهِمۡۚ فَهَلۡ عَلَي الرُّسُلِ اِلَّا الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal lazeena ashrakoo law shaaa'al laahu ma 'abadnaa min doonihee min shai'in nahnu wa laaa aabaaa'unaa wa laa harramnaa min doonihee min shai'; kazaalika fa'alal lazeena min qablihim fahal 'alar Rusuli illal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.en: And those who associate others with Allah say, "If Allah had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him." Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty of] clear notification?

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ بَعَثۡنَا فِيۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ رَّسُوۡلًا اَنِ اعۡبُدُوا اللّٰهَ وَاجۡتَنِبُوا الطَّاغُوۡتَۚ فَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ هَدَي اللّٰهُ وَمِنۡهُمۡ مَّنۡ حَقَّتۡ عَلَيۡهِ الضَّلٰلَةُؕ فَسِيۡرُوۡا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ فَانۡظُرُوۡا كَيۡفَ كَانَ عَاقِبَةُ الۡمُكَذِّبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad ba'asnaa fee kulli ummatir Rasoolan ani'budul laaha wajtanibut Taaghoota faminhum man hadal laahu wa minhum man haqqat 'alaihid dalaalah; faseeroo fil ardi fanzuroo kaifa kaana 'aaqibatul mukazzibeen
ayahs.en: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], "Worship Allah and avoid Taghut." And among them were those whom Allah guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.

ayahs.ar: اِنۡ تَحۡرِصۡ عَلٰي هُدٰىهُمۡ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ يُّضِلُّ وَمَا لَهُمۡ مِّنۡ نّٰصِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: In tahris 'alaa hudaahum fa innal laaha laa yahdee mai yudillu wa maa lahum min naasireen
ayahs.en: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, Allah does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.

ayahs.ar: وَاَقۡسَمُوۡا بِاللّٰهِ جَهۡدَ اَيۡمَانِهِمۡۙ لَا يَبۡعَثُ اللّٰهُ مَنۡ يَّمُوۡتُؕ بَلٰي وَعۡدًا عَلَيۡهِ حَقًّا وَّلٰكِنَّ اَكۡثَرَ النَّاسِ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa aqsamoo billaahi jahda aimaanihim laa yab'asul laahu mai yamoot; balaa wa'dan 'alaihi haqqanw wa laakinna aksaran naasi laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And they swear by Allah their strongest oaths [that] Allah will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.

ayahs.ar: لِيُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِيۡ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ فِيۡهِ وَلِيَعۡلَمَ الَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡ٘ا اَنَّهُمۡ كَانُوۡا كٰذِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Liyubaiyina lahumul lazee yakhtalifoona feehi wa liya'lamal lazeena kafarooo annahum kaanoo kaazibeen
ayahs.en: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا قَوۡلُنَا لِشَيۡءٍ اِذَا٘ اَرَدۡنٰهُ اَنۡ نَّقُوۡلَ لَهٗ كُنۡ فَيَكُوۡنُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innamaa qawlunaa lisha y'in izaa aradnaahu an naqoola lahoo kun fa yakoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, "Be," and it is.

ayahs.ar: وَالَّذِيۡنَ هَاجَرُوۡا فِي اللّٰهِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا ظُلِمُوۡا لَنُبَوِّئَنَّهُمۡ فِي الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةًؕ وَلَاَجۡرُ الۡاٰخِرَةِ اَكۡبَرُۘ لَوۡ كَانُوۡا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallazeena haajaroo fil laahi mim ba'di maa zulimoo lanubawwi' annahum fiddunyaa hasanatanw wa la ajrul Aakhirati akbar; law kaanoo ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] Allah after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.

ayahs.ar: الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena sabaroo wa 'alaa Rabbihim yatawak kaloon
ayahs.en: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَرۡسَلۡنَا مِنۡ قَبۡلِكَ اِلَّا رِجَالًا نُّوۡحِيۡ٘ اِلَيۡهِمۡ فَسۡـَٔلُوۡ٘ا اَهۡلَ الذِّكۡرِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa arsalnaa min qablika illaa rijaalan nooheee ilaihim; fas'alooo ahlaz zikri in kuntum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message if you do not know.

ayahs.ar: بِالۡبَيِّنٰتِ وَالزُّبُرِؕ وَاَنۡزَلۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ الذِّكۡرَ لِتُبَيِّنَ لِلنَّاسِ مَا نُزِّلَ اِلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَعَلَّهُمۡ يَتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Bilbaiyinaati waz Zubur; wa anzalnaaa ilaikaz Zikra litubaiyina linnaasi maa nuzzila ilaihim wa la'allahum yatafakkaroon
ayahs.en: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.

ayahs.ar: اَفَاَمِنَ الَّذِيۡنَ مَكَرُوا السَّيِّاٰتِ اَنۡ يَّخۡسِفَ اللّٰهُ بِهِمُ الۡاَرۡضَ اَوۡ يَاۡتِيَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ مِنۡ حَيۡثُ لَا يَشۡعُرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Afa aminal lazeena makarus saiyi aati ai yakhsifal laahu bihimul arda aw yaaa tiyahumul 'azaabu min haisu laa yash'uroon
ayahs.en: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that Allah will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ يَاۡخُذَهُمۡ فِيۡ تَقَلُّبِهِمۡ فَمَا هُمۡ بِمُعۡجِزِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Aw yaakhuzahum fee taqallubihim famaa hum bi mu'jizeen
ayahs.en: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not cause failure?

ayahs.ar: اَوۡ يَاۡخُذَهُمۡ عَلٰي تَخَوُّفٍؕ فَاِنَّ رَبَّكُمۡ لَرَءُوۡفٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Aw yaakhuzahum 'alaa takhawwuf; fa inna Rabbakum la Ra'oofur Raheem
ayahs.en: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: اَوَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلٰي مَا خَلَقَ اللّٰهُ مِنۡ شَيۡءٍ يَّتَفَيَّؤُا ظِلٰلُهٗ عَنِ الۡيَمِيۡنِ وَالشَّمَآئِلِ سُجَّدًا لِّلّٰهِ وَهُمۡ دٰخِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Awa lam yaraw ilaa maa khalaqal laahu min shai'iny-yatafaiya'u zilaaluhoo 'anil yameeni washshamaaa' ili sujjadal lillaahi wa hum daakhiroon
ayahs.en: Have they not considered what things Allah has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to Allah, while they are humble.

ayahs.ar: وَلِلّٰهِ يَسۡجُدُ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَمَا فِي الۡاَرۡضِ مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ وَّالۡمَلٰٓئِكَةُ وَهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَكۡبِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lillaahi yasjudu maa fis samaawaati wa maa fil ardi min daaabbatinw walma laaa'ikatu wa hum laa yastakbiroon
ayahs.en: And to Allah prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.

ayahs.ar: يَخَافُوۡنَ رَبَّهُمۡ مِّنۡ فَوۡقِهِمۡ وَيَفۡعَلُوۡنَ مَا يُؤۡمَرُوۡنَࣛࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: yakhaafoona Rabbahum min fawqihim wa yaf'aloona maa yu'maroon
ayahs.en: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.

ayahs.ar: وَقَالَ اللّٰهُ لَا تَتَّخِذُوۡ٘ا اِلٰهَيۡنِ اثۡنَيۡنِۚ اِنَّمَا هُوَ اِلٰهٌ وَّاحِدٌۚ فَاِيَّايَ فَارۡهَبُوۡنِ
ayahs.tl: Wa qaalal laahu laa tatta khizooo ilaahainis naini innamaa Huwa Ilaahunw Waahid; fa iyyaaya farhaboon
ayahs.en: And Allah has said, "Do not take for yourselves two deities. He is but one God, so fear only Me."

ayahs.ar: وَلَهٗ مَا فِي السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ وَلَهُ الدِّيۡنُ وَاصِبًاؕ اَفَغَيۡرَ اللّٰهِ تَتَّقُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa lahoo maa fis samaawaati wal ardi wa lahud deenu waasibaa; afaghairal laahi tattaqoon
ayahs.en: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than Allah that you fear?

ayahs.ar: وَمَا بِكُمۡ مِّنۡ نِّعۡمَةٍ فَمِنَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ اِذَا مَسَّكُمُ الضُّرُّ فَاِلَيۡهِ تَجۡـَٔرُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa maa bikum minni'matin faminal laahi summa izaa massakumud durru fa ilaihi taj'aroon
ayahs.en: And whatever you have of favor - it is from Allah. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِذَا كَشَفَ الضُّرَّ عَنۡكُمۡ اِذَا فَرِيۡقٌ مِّنۡكُمۡ بِرَبِّهِمۡ يُشۡرِكُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Summaa izaa kashafad durra 'ankum izaa fareequm minkum bi Rabbihim yushrikoon
ayahs.en: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord

ayahs.ar: لِيَكۡفُرُوۡا بِمَا٘ اٰتَيۡنٰهُمۡؕ فَتَمَتَّعُوۡاࣞ فَسَوۡفَ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Liyakfuroo bimaa aatainaahum; fatamatta'oo, faswfa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.

ayahs.ar: وَيَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لِمَا لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ نَصِيۡبًا مِّمَّا رَزَقۡنٰهُمۡؕ تَاللّٰهِ لَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنۡتُمۡ تَفۡتَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaj'aloona limaa laa ya'lamoona naseebam mimmaa razaqnnaahum; tallaahi latus'alunaa 'ammaa kuntum taftaroon
ayahs.en: And they assign to what they do not know a portion of that which We have provided them. By Allah, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.

ayahs.ar: وَيَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ الۡبَنٰتِ سُبۡحٰنَهٗۙ وَلَهُمۡ مَّا يَشۡتَهُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaj'aloona lillaahil banaati Subhaanahoo wa lahum maa yashtahoon
ayahs.en: And they attribute to Allah daughters - exalted is He - and for them is what they desire.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا بُشِّرَ اَحَدُهُمۡ بِالۡاُنۡثٰي ظَلَّ وَجۡهُهٗ مُسۡوَدًّا وَّهُوَ كَظِيۡمٌۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa bushshira ahaduhum bil unsaa zalla wajhuhoo muswaddanw wa huwa kazeem
ayahs.en: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.

ayahs.ar: يَتَوَارٰي مِنَ الۡقَوۡمِ مِنۡ سُوۡٓءِ مَا بُشِّرَ بِهٖؕ اَيُمۡسِكُهٗ عَلٰي هُوۡنٍ اَمۡ يَدُسُّهٗ فِي التُّرَابِؕ اَلَا سَآءَ مَا يَحۡكُمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: yatawaaraa minal qawmimin sooo'i maa bushshira bih; a-yumsikuhoo 'alaa hoonin am yadussuhoo fit turaab; alaa saaa'a maa yahkumoon
ayahs.en: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Unquestionably, evil is what they decide.

ayahs.ar: لِلَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِالۡاٰخِرَةِ مَثَلُ السَّوۡءِۚ وَلِلّٰهِ الۡمَثَلُ الۡاَعۡلٰيؕ وَهُوَ الۡعَزِيۡزُ الۡحَكِيۡمُࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Lillazeena laa yu'minoona bil Aakhirati masalus saw'i wa lillaahil masalul a'laa; wa Huwal 'Azeezul Hakeem
ayahs.en: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description of evil; and for Allah is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ يُؤَاخِذُ اللّٰهُ النَّاسَ بِظُلۡمِهِمۡ مَّا تَرَكَ عَلَيۡهَا مِنۡ دَآبَّةٍ وَّلٰكِنۡ يُّؤَخِّرُهُمۡ اِلٰ٘ي اَجَلٍ مُّسَمًّيۚ فَاِذَا جَآءَ اَجَلُهُمۡ لَا يَسۡتَاۡخِرُوۡنَ سَاعَةً وَّلَا يَسۡتَقۡدِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law yu'aakhizul laahun naasa bizulminhim maa taraka 'alaihaa min daaabbatinw wa laakiny yu'akhkhiruhum ilaaa ajalim musamman fa izaa jaaa'a ajaluhum laa yastaakhiroona saa'atanw wa laa yastaqdimoon
ayahs.en: And if Allah were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon the earth any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].

ayahs.ar: وَيَجۡعَلُوۡنَ لِلّٰهِ مَا يَكۡرَهُوۡنَ وَتَصِفُ اَلۡسِنَتُهُمُ الۡكَذِبَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ الۡحُسۡنٰيؕ لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّ لَهُمُ النَّارَ وَاَنَّهُمۡ مُّفۡرَطُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yaj'aloona lillaahi maa yakrahoona wa tasifu alsinatuhumul kaziba anna lahumul husnaa laa jarama anna lahumun Naara wa annahum mufratoon
ayahs.en: And they attribute to Allah that which they dislike, and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.

ayahs.ar: تَاللّٰهِ لَقَدۡ اَرۡسَلۡنَا٘ اِلٰ٘ي اُمَمٍ مِّنۡ قَبۡلِكَ فَزَيَّنَ لَهُمُ الشَّيۡطٰنُ اَعۡمَالَهُمۡ فَهُوَ وَلِيُّهُمُ الۡيَوۡمَ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Tallaahi laqad arsalnaaa ilaaa umamim min qablika fazayyana lahumush Shaitaanu a'maalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumul yawma wa lahum 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: By Allah, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is the disbelievers' ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَمَا٘ اَنۡزَلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ اِلَّا لِتُبَيِّنَ لَهُمُ الَّذِي اخۡتَلَفُوۡا فِيۡهِۙ وَهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa maaa anzalnaa 'alaikal Kitaaba illaa litubaiyina lahumul lazikh talafoo feehi wa hudanw wa rahmatal liqawminy yu'minoon
ayahs.en: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ اَنۡزَلَ مِنَ السَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَاَحۡيَا بِهِ الۡاَرۡضَ بَعۡدَ مَوۡتِهَاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّسۡمَعُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu anzala minas samaaa'i maaa'an fa ahyaa bihil arda ba'da mawtihaa; inna fee zaalika la aayatal liqaw miny yasma'oon
ayahs.en: And Allah has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنَّ لَكُمۡ فِي الۡاَنۡعَامِ لَعِبۡرَةًؕ نُسۡقِيۡكُمۡ مِّمَّا فِيۡ بُطُوۡنِهٖ مِنۭۡ بَيۡنِ فَرۡثٍ وَّدَمٍ لَّبَنًا خَالِصًا سَآئِغًا لِّلشّٰرِبِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa inna lakum fil an'aami la'ibrah; nusqeekum mimmmaa fee butoonihee mim baini farsinw wa damil labanann khaalisan saaa'ighallish shaaribeen
ayahs.en: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.

ayahs.ar: وَمِنۡ ثَمَرٰتِ النَّخِيۡلِ وَالۡاَعۡنَابِ تَتَّخِذُوۡنَ مِنۡهُ سَكَرًا وَّرِزۡقًا حَسَنًاؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّعۡقِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa min samaraatin nakheeli wal a'nnaabi tattakhizoona minhu sakaranw wa rizqann hasanaa; inna fee zaalika la Aayatal liqawminy ya'qiloon
ayahs.en: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.

ayahs.ar: وَاَوۡحٰي رَبُّكَ اِلَي النَّحۡلِ اَنِ اتَّخِذِيۡ مِنَ الۡجِبَالِ بُيُوۡتًا وَّمِنَ الشَّجَرِ وَمِمَّا يَعۡرِشُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa awhaa Rabbuka ilannnabli anit takhizee minal jabaali buyootanw wa minash shajari wa mimmaa ya'rishoon
ayahs.en: And your Lord inspired to the bee, "Take for yourself among the mountains, houses, and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ كُلِيۡ مِنۡ كُلِّ الثَّمَرٰتِ فَاسۡلُكِيۡ سُبُلَ رَبِّكِ ذُلُلًاؕ يَخۡرُجُ مِنۭۡ بُطُوۡنِهَا شَرَابٌ مُّخۡتَلِفٌ اَلۡوَانُهٗ فِيۡهِ شِفَآءٌ لِّلنَّاسِؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيَةً لِّقَوۡمٍ يَّتَفَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summma kulee min kullis samaraati faslukee subula Rabbiki zululaa; yakhruju mim butoonihaa sharaabum mukh talifun alwaanuhoo feehi shifaaa'ul linnaas, innna fee zaalika la Aayatal liqawminy yatafakkaroon
ayahs.en: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you]." There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colors, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ خَلَقَكُمۡ ثُمَّ يَتَوَفّٰىكُمۡ وَمِنۡكُمۡ مَّنۡ يُّرَدُّ اِلٰ٘ي اَرۡذَلِ الۡعُمُرِ لِكَيۡ لَا يَعۡلَمَ بَعۡدَ عِلۡمٍ شَيۡـًٔاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلِيۡمٌ قَدِيۡرٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu khalaqakum suma tatawaffaakum; wa minkum many-yuradu ilaaa arzalil 'umuri likai laa ya'lama ba'da 'ilmin shai'aa; innal laaha 'Aleemun Qadeer
ayahs.en: And Allah created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, Allah is Knowing and Competent.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ فَضَّلَ بَعۡضَكُمۡ عَلٰي بَعۡضٍ فِي الرِّزۡقِۚ فَمَا الَّذِيۡنَ فُضِّلُوۡا بِرَآدِّيۡ رِزۡقِهِمۡ عَلٰي مَا مَلَكَتۡ اَيۡمَانُهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيۡهِ سَوَآءٌؕ اَفَبِنِعۡمَةِ اللّٰهِ يَجۡحَدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu faddala ba'dakum 'alaa ba'din fir rizq; famal lazeena fuddiloo biraaaddee rizqihim 'alaa maa malakat aimaanuhum fahum feehi sawaaa'; afabini'matil laahi yajhadoon
ayahs.en: And Allah has favored some of you over others in provision. But those who were favored would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favor of Allah they reject?

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِكُمۡ اَزۡوَاجًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ اَزۡوَاجِكُمۡ بَنِيۡنَ وَحَفَدَةً وَّرَزَقَكُمۡ مِّنَ الطَّيِّبٰتِؕ اَفَبِالۡبَاطِلِ يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ وَبِنِعۡمَتِ اللّٰهِ هُمۡ يَكۡفُرُوۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum min anfusikum azwaajanw wa ja'ala lakum min azwaajikum baneena wa hafadatanw wa razaqakum minat yaiyibaat; afabil baatili yu'minoona wa bini'matil laahi hum yakkfuroon
ayahs.en: And Allah has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favor of Allah they disbelieve?

ayahs.ar: وَيَعۡبُدُوۡنَ مِنۡ دُوۡنِ اللّٰهِ مَا لَا يَمۡلِكُ لَهُمۡ رِزۡقًا مِّنَ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِ شَيۡـًٔا وَّلَا يَسۡتَطِيۡعُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa ya'budoona min doonil laahi maa laa yamliku lahum rizqam minas samaawaati wal ardi shai'anw wa laa yastatee'oon
ayahs.en: And they worship besides Allah that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.

ayahs.ar: فَلَا تَضۡرِبُوۡا لِلّٰهِ الۡاَمۡثَالَؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ وَاَنۡتُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Falaa tadriboo lillaahil amsaal; innal laaha ya'lamu wa antum laa ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: So do not assert similarities to Allah. Indeed, Allah knows and you do not know.

ayahs.ar: ضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا عَبۡدًا مَّمۡلُوۡكًا لَّا يَقۡدِرُ عَلٰي شَيۡءٍ وَّمَنۡ رَّزَقۡنٰهُ مِنَّا رِزۡقًا حَسَنًا فَهُوَ يُنۡفِقُ مِنۡهُ سِرًّا وَّجَهۡرًاؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوٗنَؕ اَلۡحَمۡدُ لِلّٰهِؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Darabal laahu masalan 'abdam mammlookal laa yaqdiru 'alaa shai'inw wa marrazaqnaahu mminnaa rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirranw wa jahra; hal yasta-woon; alhamdu lillaah; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: Allah presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to Allah! But most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: وَضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا رَّجُلَيۡنِ اَحَدُهُمَا٘ اَبۡكَمُ لَا يَقۡدِرُ عَلٰي شَيۡءٍ وَّهُوَ كَلٌّ عَلٰي مَوۡلٰىهُۙ اَيۡنَمَا يُوَجِّهۡهُّ لَا يَاۡتِ بِخَيۡرٍؕ هَلۡ يَسۡتَوِيۡ هُوَۙ وَمَنۡ يَّاۡمُرُ بِالۡعَدۡلِۙ وَهُوَ عَلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa darabal laahu masalar rajulaini ahaduhumaaa abkamu laa yaqdiru 'alaa shai'inw wa huwa kallun 'alaa mawlaahu ainamaa yuwajjihhu laa yaati bikhairin hal yastawee huwa wa many-yaamuru bil'adli wa huwa 'alaa Siraatim MMustaqeem
ayahs.en: And Allah presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?

ayahs.ar: وَلِلّٰهِ غَيۡبُ السَّمٰوٰتِ وَالۡاَرۡضِؕ وَمَا٘ اَمۡرُ السَّاعَةِ اِلَّا كَلَمۡحِ الۡبَصَرِ اَوۡ هُوَ اَقۡرَبُؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ عَلٰي كُلِّ شَيۡءٍ قَدِيۡرٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa lillaahi ghaibus samaawaati wal ard; wa maaa amrus Saa'ati illaa kalamhil basari aw huwa aqrab; innal laaha 'alaaa kulli shai'in Qadeer
ayahs.en: And to Allah belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, Allah is over all things competent.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ اَخۡرَجَكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بُطُوۡنِ اُمَّهٰتِكُمۡ لَا تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ شَيۡـًٔاۙ وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمُ السَّمۡعَ وَالۡاَبۡصَارَ وَالۡاَفۡـِٕدَةَۙ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَشۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu akhrajakum mim butooni ummahaatikum laa ta'lamoona shai'anw wa ja'ala lakumus sam'a wal absaara wal af'idata la'allakum tashkuroon
ayahs.en: And Allah has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and intellect that perhaps you would be grateful.

ayahs.ar: اَلَمۡ يَرَوۡا اِلَي الطَّيۡرِ مُسَخَّرٰتٍ فِيۡ جَوِّ السَّمَآءِؕ مَا يُمۡسِكُهُنَّ اِلَّا اللّٰهُؕ اِنَّ فِيۡ ذٰلِكَ لَاٰيٰتٍ لِّقَوۡمٍ يُّؤۡمِنُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Alam yaraw ilat tairi musakhkharaatin fee jawwis samaaa'i maa yumsikuhunna illal laah; inna fee zaalika la Aayaatil liqawminy yu'minoon
ayahs.en: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except Allah. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۭۡ بُيُوۡتِكُمۡ سَكَنًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنۡ جُلُوۡدِ الۡاَنۡعَامِ بُيُوۡتًا تَسۡتَخِفُّوۡنَهَا يَوۡمَ ظَعۡنِكُمۡ وَيَوۡمَ اِقَامَتِكُمۡۙ وَمِنۡ اَصۡوَافِهَا وَاَوۡبَارِهَا وَاَشۡعَارِهَا٘ اَثَاثًا وَّمَتَاعًا اِلٰي حِيۡنٍ
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum min juloodil an'aami buyootan tastakhif foonahaa yawma za'nikum wa yawma iqaamatikum wa min aswaafihaa wa awbaarihaa wa ash'aarihaaa asaasanw wa mataa'an ilaa been
ayahs.en: And Allah has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment for a time.

ayahs.ar: وَاللّٰهُ جَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّمَّا خَلَقَ ظِلٰلًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ مِّنَ الۡجِبَالِ اَكۡنَانًا وَّجَعَلَ لَكُمۡ سَرَابِيۡلَ تَقِيۡكُمُ الۡحَرَّ وَسَرَابِيۡلَ تَقِيۡكُمۡ بَاۡسَكُمۡؕ كَذٰلِكَ يُتِمُّ نِعۡمَتَهٗ عَلَيۡكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تُسۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wallaahu ja'ala lakum mimmaa khalaqa zilaalanw wa ja'ala lakum minal jibaali aknaananw wa ja'ala lakum saraabeela taqeekumul harra wa saraabeela taqeekum baasakum; kazaalika yutimmu ni'matahoo alaikum la'allakum tuslimoon
ayahs.en: And Allah has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favor upon you that you might submit [to Him].

ayahs.ar: فَاِنۡ تَوَلَّوۡا فَاِنَّمَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡبَلٰغُ الۡمُبِيۡنُ
ayahs.tl: Fa in tawallaw fa innamaa 'alaikal balaaghul mubeen
ayahs.en: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] - then only upon you is [responsibility for] clear notification.

ayahs.ar: يَعۡرِفُوۡنَ نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ ثُمَّ يُنۡكِرُوۡنَهَا وَاَكۡثَرُهُمُ الۡكٰفِرُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Ya'rifoona ni'matal laahi summa yunkiroonahaa wa aksaruhumul kaafiroon
ayahs.en: They recognize the favor of Allah; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ مِنۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِيۡدًا ثُمَّ لَا يُؤۡذَنُ لِلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَلَا هُمۡ يُسۡتَعۡتَبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa yawma nab'asu min kulli ummatin shaheedan summa laa yu'zanu lillazeena kafaroo wa laa hum yusta'taboon
ayahs.en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [Allah].

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَ الَّذِيۡنَ ظَلَمُوا الۡعَذَابَ فَلَا يُخَفَّفُ عَنۡهُمۡ وَلَا هُمۡ يُنۡظَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa ra al lazeena zalamul 'azaaba falaa yukhaf fafu 'anhum wa laa hum yunzaroon
ayahs.en: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا رَاَ الَّذِيۡنَ اَشۡرَكُوۡا شُرَكَآءَهُمۡ قَالُوۡا رَبَّنَا هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِ شُرَكَآؤُنَا الَّذِيۡنَ كُنَّا نَدۡعُوۡا مِنۡ دُوۡنِكَۚ فَاَلۡقَوۡا اِلَيۡهِمُ الۡقَوۡلَ اِنَّكُمۡ لَكٰذِبُوۡنَۚ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa ra al lazeena ashrakoo shurakaaa'ahum qaaloo Rabbana haaa'ulaaa'i shurakaaa'unal lazeena kunnaa nad'oo min doonika fa alqaw ilaihimul qawla innakum lakaaziboon
ayahs.en: And when those who associated others with Allah see their "partners," they will say," Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You." But they will throw at them the statement, "Indeed, you are liars."

ayahs.ar: وَاَلۡقَوۡا اِلَي اللّٰهِ يَوۡمَئِذِ اِۨلسَّلَمَ وَضَلَّ عَنۡهُمۡ مَّا كَانُوۡا يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa alqaw ilal laahi yawma'izinis salama wa dalla 'anhum maa kaanoo yaftaroon
ayahs.en: And they will impart to Allah that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.

ayahs.ar: اَلَّذِيۡنَ كَفَرُوۡا وَصَدُّوۡا عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِ زِدۡنٰهُمۡ عَذَابًا فَوۡقَ الۡعَذَابِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يُفۡسِدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Allazeena kafaroo wa saddoo 'an sabeelil laahi zidnaahum 'azaaban fawqal 'azaabi bimaa kaanoo yufsidoon
ayahs.en: Those who disbelieved and averted [others] from the way of Allah - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.

ayahs.ar: وَيَوۡمَ نَبۡعَثُ فِيۡ كُلِّ اُمَّةٍ شَهِيۡدًا عَلَيۡهِمۡ مِّنۡ اَنۡفُسِهِمۡ وَجِئۡنَا بِكَ شَهِيۡدًا عَلٰي هٰ٘ؤُلَآءِؕ وَنَزَّلۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ الۡكِتٰبَ تِبۡيَانًا لِّكُلِّ شَيۡءٍ وَّهُدًي وَّرَحۡمَةً وَّبُشۡرٰي لِلۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa yawma nab'asu fee kulli ummmatin shaheedan 'alaihim min anfusihim wa ji'naa bika shaheedan 'alaa haaa'ulaaa'; wa nazzalnaa 'alaikal Kitaaba tibyaanal likulli shai'inw wa hudanw wa rahmatanw wa bushraa lilmuslimeen
ayahs.en: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over your nation. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَاۡمُرُ بِالۡعَدۡلِ وَالۡاِحۡسَانِ وَاِيۡتَآئِ ذِي الۡقُرۡبٰي وَيَنۡهٰي عَنِ الۡفَحۡشَآءِ وَالۡمُنۡكَرِ وَالۡبَغۡيِۚ يَعِظُكُمۡ لَعَلَّكُمۡ تَذَكَّرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha yaamaru bil 'adli wal ihsaani wa eetaaa'i zil qurbaa wa yanhaa 'anil fahshaaa'i wal munkari walbagh-i' ya'izukum la'allakum tazakkkaroon
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah orders justice and good conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.

ayahs.ar: وَاَوۡفُوۡا بِعَهۡدِ اللّٰهِ اِذَا عٰهَدۡتُّمۡ وَلَا تَنۡقُضُوا الۡاَيۡمَانَ بَعۡدَ تَوۡكِيۡدِهَا وَقَدۡ جَعَلۡتُمُ اللّٰهَ عَلَيۡكُمۡ كَفِيۡلًاؕ اِنَّ اللّٰهَ يَعۡلَمُ مَا تَفۡعَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa awfoo bi Ahdil laahi izaa 'aahattum wa laa tanqudul aimaana ba'da tawkeedihaa wa qad ja'altumul laaha 'alaikum kafeelaa; innal laaha ya'lamu maa taf'aloon
ayahs.en: And fulfill the covenant of Allah when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made Allah, over you, a witness. Indeed, Allah knows what you do.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَكُوۡنُوۡا كَالَّتِيۡ نَقَضَتۡ غَزۡلَهَا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ قُوَّةٍ اَنۡكَاثًاؕ تَتَّخِذُوۡنَ اَيۡمَانَكُمۡ دَخَلًاۭ بَيۡنَكُمۡ اَنۡ تَكُوۡنَ اُمَّةٌ هِيَ اَرۡبٰي مِنۡ اُمَّةٍؕ اِنَّمَا يَبۡلُوۡكُمُ اللّٰهُ بِهٖؕ وَلَيُبَيِّنَنَّ لَكُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ مَا كُنۡتُمۡ فِيۡهِ تَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa takoonoo kallatee naqadat ghazlahaa mim ba'di quwwatin ankaasaa; tattakhizoona aimaanakum dakhlalam bainakum an takoona ummatun hiya arbaa min ummah; innnamaa yablookumul laahu bih; wa la yubaiyinanna lakum yawmal Qiyaamati maa kuntum fee takhtalifoon
ayahs.en: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. Allah only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.

ayahs.ar: وَلَوۡ شَآءَ اللّٰهُ لَجَعَلَكُمۡ اُمَّةً وَّاحِدَةً وَّلٰكِنۡ يُّضِلُّ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُ وَيَهۡدِيۡ مَنۡ يَّشَآءُؕ وَلَتُسۡـَٔلُنَّ عَمَّا كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa law shaaa'al laahu laja'alakum ummmatanw waahidatanw wa laakiny yudillu many-yashaaa'u wa yahdee many-yashaaa'; wa latus'alunna 'ammaa kuntum ta'maloon
ayahs.en: And if Allah had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَتَّخِذُوۡ٘ا اَيۡمَانَكُمۡ دَخَلًاۭ بَيۡنَكُمۡ فَتَزِلَّ قَدَمٌۭ بَعۡدَ ثُبُوۡتِهَا وَتَذُوۡقُوا السُّوۡٓءَ بِمَا صَدَدۡتُّمۡ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِ اللّٰهِۚ وَلَكُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tattakhizooo aimaanakum dakhalam bainakum ftazilla qadamum ba'da subootihaa wa tazooqus sooo'a bimmaa sadattum 'an sabeelil laahi wa lakum 'azaabun 'azeem
ayahs.en: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you diverted from the way of Allah, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَشۡتَرُوۡا بِعَهۡدِ اللّٰهِ ثَمَنًا قَلِيۡلًاؕ اِنَّمَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ هُوَ خَيۡرٌ لَّكُمۡ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ تَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laa tashtaroo bi 'ahdil laahi samanan qaleelaa; innamaa 'indal laahi huwa khairul lakum in kuntum ta'lamoon
ayahs.en: And do not exchange the covenant of Allah for a small price. Indeed, what is with Allah is best for you, if only you could know.

ayahs.ar: مَا عِنۡدَكُمۡ يَنۡفَدُ وَمَا عِنۡدَ اللّٰهِ بَاقٍؕ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ صَبَرُوۡ٘ا اَجۡرَهُمۡ بِاَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: maa 'indakum yanfadu wa maa 'indal laahi baaq; wa lanajziyannal lazeena sabarooo ajjrahum bi ahsani maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: Whatever you have will end, but what Allah has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ عَمِلَ صَالِحًا مِّنۡ ذَكَرٍ اَوۡ اُنۡثٰي وَهُوَ مُؤۡمِنٌ فَلَنُحۡيِيَنَّهٗ حَيٰوةً طَيِّبَةًۚ وَلَنَجۡزِيَنَّهُمۡ اَجۡرَهُمۡ بِاَحۡسَنِ مَا كَانُوۡا يَعۡمَلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Man 'amila saaliham min zakarin aw unsaa wa huwa mu'minun falanuhyiyannahoo hayaatan taiiyibatanw wa lanajzi yannnahum ajrahum bi ahsani maa kaanoo ya'maloon
ayahs.en: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.

ayahs.ar: فَاِذَا قَرَاۡتَ الۡقُرۡاٰنَ فَاسۡتَعِذۡ بِاللّٰهِ مِنَ الشَّيۡطٰنِ الرَّجِيۡمِ
ayahs.tl: Fa izaa qara tal Quraana fasta'iz billaahi minashh Shai taanir rajeem
ayahs.en: So when you recite the Qur'an, [first] seek refuge in Allah from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].

ayahs.ar: اِنَّهٗ لَيۡسَ لَهٗ سُلۡطٰنٌ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَعَلٰي رَبِّهِمۡ يَتَوَكَّلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innahoo laisa lahoo sultaanun 'alal lazeena aamanoo wa 'alaa Rabbihim yatawakkaloon
ayahs.en: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا سُلۡطٰنُهٗ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ يَتَوَلَّوۡنَهٗ وَالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ بِهٖ مُشۡرِكُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innnamaa sultaanuhoo 'alal lazeena yatawallawnahoo wallazeena hum bihee mushrikoon
ayahs.en: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with Allah.

ayahs.ar: وَاِذَا بَدَّلۡنَا٘ اٰيَةً مَّكَانَ اٰيَةٍۙ وَّاللّٰهُ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يُنَزِّلُ قَالُوۡ٘ا اِنَّمَا٘ اَنۡتَ مُفۡتَرٍؕ بَلۡ اَكۡثَرُهُمۡ لَا يَعۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa izaa baddalnaaa Aayatam makaana Aayatinw wal laahu a'lamu bimaa yunazzilu qaalooo innamaa anta muftar; bal aksaruhum laa ya'lamoon
ayahs.en: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and Allah is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, "You, [O Muhammad], are but an inventor [of lies]." But most of them do not know.

ayahs.ar: قُلۡ نَزَّلَهٗ رُوۡحُ الۡقُدُسِ مِنۡ رَّبِّكَ بِالۡحَقِّ لِيُثَبِّتَ الَّذِيۡنَ اٰمَنُوۡا وَهُدًي وَّبُشۡرٰي لِلۡمُسۡلِمِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Qul nazzalahoo Roohul Qudusi mir Rabbika bilhaqqi liyusabbital lazeena aamanoo wa hudanw wa bushraa lilmuslimeen
ayahs.en: Say, [O Muhammad], "The Pure Spirit has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims."

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ نَعۡلَمُ اَنَّهُمۡ يَقُوۡلُوۡنَ اِنَّمَا يُعَلِّمُهٗ بَشَرٌؕ لِسَانُ الَّذِيۡ يُلۡحِدُوۡنَ اِلَيۡهِ اَعۡجَمِيٌّ وَّهٰذَا لِسَانٌ عَرَبِيٌّ مُّبِيۡنٌ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad na'lamu annahum yaqooloona innamaa yu'allimuhoo bashar; lisaanul lazee yulhidoona ilaihi a'ja miyyunw wa haaza lisaanun 'Arabiyyum mubeen
ayahs.en: And We certainly know that they say, "It is only a human being who teaches the Prophet." The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this Qur'an is [in] a clear Arabic language.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِۙ لَا يَهۡدِيۡهِمُ اللّٰهُ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Innal lazeena laa yu'minoona bi Aayaatil laahi laa yahdehimul laahu wa lahum 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of Allah - Allah will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا يَفۡتَرِي الۡكَذِبَ الَّذِيۡنَ لَا يُؤۡمِنُوۡنَ بِاٰيٰتِ اللّٰهِۚ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡكٰذِبُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innamaa yaftaril kazibal lazeena laa yu'minoona bi Aayaatil laahi wa ulaaa'ika humul kaaziboon
ayahs.en: They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of Allah, and it is those who are the liars.

ayahs.ar: مَنۡ كَفَرَ بِاللّٰهِ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ اِيۡمَانِهٖ٘ اِلَّا مَنۡ اُكۡرِهَ وَقَلۡبُهٗ مُطۡمَئِنٌّۭ بِالۡاِيۡمَانِ وَلٰكِنۡ مَّنۡ شَرَحَ بِالۡكُفۡرِ صَدۡرًا فَعَلَيۡهِمۡ غَضَبٌ مِّنَ اللّٰهِۚ وَلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ عَظِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: man kafara billaahi mim ba'di eemaanihee illaa man ukriha wa qalbuhoo mutmma'innum bil eemaani wa laakim man sharaha bilkufri sadran fa'alaihim ghadabum minal laahi wa lahum 'azaabun 'azeem
ayahs.en: Whoever disbelieves in Allah after his belief... except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from Allah, and for them is a great punishment;

ayahs.ar: ذٰلِكَ بِاَنَّهُمُ اسۡتَحَبُّوا الۡحَيٰوةَ الدُّنۡيَا عَلَي الۡاٰخِرَةِۙ وَاَنَّ اللّٰهَ لَا يَهۡدِي الۡقَوۡمَ الۡكٰفِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Zaalika bi annahumus tahabbul hayaatad dunyaa 'alal Aakhirati wa annal laaha laa yahdil qawmal kaafireen
ayahs.en: That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that Allah does not guide the disbelieving people.

ayahs.ar: اُولٰٓئِكَ الَّذِيۡنَ طَبَعَ اللّٰهُ عَلٰي قُلُوۡبِهِمۡ وَسَمۡعِهِمۡ وَاَبۡصَارِهِمۡۚ وَاُولٰٓئِكَ هُمُ الۡغٰفِلُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ulaaa'ikal lazeena taba'al laahu 'alaa quloobihim wa sam'ihim wa absaarihim wa ulaaa'ika humul ghaafiloon
ayahs.en: Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision Allah has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless.

ayahs.ar: لَا جَرَمَ اَنَّهُمۡ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ هُمُ الۡخٰسِرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Laa jarama annnahum fil Aakhirati humul khassiroon
ayahs.en: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ هَاجَرُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ مَا فُتِنُوۡا ثُمَّ جٰهَدُوۡا وَصَبَرُوۡ٘اۙ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Summa inna Rabbaka lillazeena haajaroo mim ba'dimaa futinoo summma jaahadoo wa sabaroo inna Rabbaka mim ba'dihaa la Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of Allah] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful

ayahs.ar: يَوۡمَ تَاۡتِيۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ تُجَادِلُ عَنۡ نَّفۡسِهَا وَتُوَفّٰي كُلُّ نَفۡسٍ مَّا عَمِلَتۡ وَهُمۡ لَا يُظۡلَمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Yawma taatee kullu nafsin tujaadilu 'an nafsihaa wa tuwaffaa kullu nafsim maa 'amilat wa hum laa yuzlamoon
ayahs.en: On the Day when every soul will come disputing for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged.

ayahs.ar: وَضَرَبَ اللّٰهُ مَثَلًا قَرۡيَةً كَانَتۡ اٰمِنَةً مُّطۡمَئِنَّةً يَّاۡتِيۡهَا رِزۡقُهَا رَغَدًا مِّنۡ كُلِّ مَكَانٍ فَكَفَرَتۡ بِاَنۡعُمِ اللّٰهِ فَاَذَاقَهَا اللّٰهُ لِبَاسَ الۡجُوۡعِ وَالۡخَوۡفِ بِمَا كَانُوۡا يَصۡنَعُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa darabal laahu masalan qaryatan kaanat aaminatam mutma'innatany yaaateehaa rizquhaa rghadam min kulli makaanin fakafarat bi an'umil laahi fa azaaqahal laahu libaasal joo'i walkhawfi bimaa kaanoo yasna'oon
ayahs.en: And Allah presents an example: a city which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favors of Allah. So Allah made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing.

ayahs.ar: وَلَقَدۡ جَآءَهُمۡ رَسُوۡلٌ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَكَذَّبُوۡهُ فَاَخَذَهُمُ الۡعَذَابُ وَهُمۡ ظٰلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa laqad jaaa'ahum Rasoolum minhum fakazzaboohu fa akhazahumul 'azaabu wa hum zaalimoon
ayahs.en: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers.

ayahs.ar: فَكُلُوۡا مِمَّا رَزَقَكُمُ اللّٰهُ حَلٰلًا طَيِّبًاࣕ وَّاشۡكُرُوۡا نِعۡمَتَ اللّٰهِ اِنۡ كُنۡتُمۡ اِيَّاهُ تَعۡبُدُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Fakuloo mimmaa razaqa kumul laahu halaalan taiyibanw washkuroo ni'matal laahi in kuntum iyyaahu ta'budoon
ayahs.en: Then eat of what Allah has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And be grateful for the favor of Allah, if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا حَرَّمَ عَلَيۡكُمُ الۡمَيۡتَةَ وَالدَّمَ وَلَحۡمَ الۡخِنۡزِيۡرِ وَمَا٘ اُهِلَّ لِغَيۡرِ اللّٰهِ بِهٖۚ فَمَنِ اضۡطُرَّ غَيۡرَ بَاغٍ وَّلَا عَادٍ فَاِنَّ اللّٰهَ غَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Innamaa harrma 'alai kumul maitata waddama wa lahmal khinzeeri wa maaa uhilla lighairil laahi bihee famanid turra ghaira baaghinw wa laa 'aadin fa innal laaha Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than Allah. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, Allah is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: وَلَا تَقُوۡلُوۡا لِمَا تَصِفُ اَلۡسِنَتُكُمُ الۡكَذِبَ هٰذَا حَلٰلٌ وَّهٰذَا حَرَامٌ لِّتَفۡتَرُوۡا عَلَي اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَؕ اِنَّ الَّذِيۡنَ يَفۡتَرُوۡنَ عَلَي اللّٰهِ الۡكَذِبَ لَا يُفۡلِحُوۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa laa taqooloo limaa tasifu alsinatukumul kaziba haaza halaalunw wa haazaa haraamul litaftaroo 'alal laahil kazib; innal lazeena yaftaroona 'alal laahil kaziba laa yuflihoon
ayahs.en: And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, "This is lawful and this is unlawful," to invent falsehood about Allah. Indeed, those who invent falsehood about Allah will not succeed.

ayahs.ar: مَتَاعٌ قَلِيۡلٌࣕ وَّلَهُمۡ عَذَابٌ اَلِيۡمٌ
ayahs.tl: Mata'un qaleelunw wa lahum 'azaabun aleem
ayahs.en: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.

ayahs.ar: وَعَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ هَادُوۡا حَرَّمۡنَا مَا قَصَصۡنَا عَلَيۡكَ مِنۡ قَبۡلُۚ وَمَا ظَلَمۡنٰهُمۡ وَلٰكِنۡ كَانُوۡ٘ا اَنۡفُسَهُمۡ يَظۡلِمُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa 'alal lazeena haadoo harramnaa ma qasasnaa 'alaika min qablu wa maa zalamanaahum wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum wa laakin kaanoo anfusahum yazlimoon
ayahs.en: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ لِلَّذِيۡنَ عَمِلُوا السُّوۡٓءَ بِجَهَالَةٍ ثُمَّ تَابُوۡا مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِ ذٰلِكَ وَاَصۡلَحُوۡ٘ا اِنَّ رَبَّكَ مِنۭۡ بَعۡدِهَا لَغَفُوۡرٌ رَّحِيۡمٌࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Summma inna Rabbaka lillazeena 'amilus sooo'a bijahaalatin summa taaboo mim ba'di zaaalika wa aslahoo inna Rabbaka mim ba'dihaa la Ghafoorur Raheem
ayahs.en: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ كَانَ اُمَّةً قَانِتًا لِّلّٰهِ حَنِيۡفًاؕ وَلَمۡ يَكُ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَۙ‏
ayahs.tl: Inna Ibraaheema kaana ummatan qaanital lillaahi Haneefanw wa lam yakuminal mushrikeen
ayahs.en: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to Allah, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with Allah.

ayahs.ar: شَاكِرًا لِّاَنۡعُمِهٖؕ اِجۡتَبٰىهُ وَهَدٰىهُ اِلٰي صِرَاطٍ مُّسۡتَقِيۡمٍ
ayahs.tl: Shaakiral li an'umih; ijtabaahu wa hadaahu ilaa Siraatim Muustaqeem
ayahs.en: [He was] grateful for His favors. Allah chose him and guided him to a straight path.

ayahs.ar: وَاٰتَيۡنٰهُ فِي الدُّنۡيَا حَسَنَةًؕ وَاِنَّهٗ فِي الۡاٰخِرَةِ لَمِنَ الصّٰلِحِيۡنَؕ‏
ayahs.tl: Wa aatainaahu fid dunyaa hasanah; wa innahoo fil Aakhirati laminas saaliheen
ayahs.en: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.

ayahs.ar: ثُمَّ اَوۡحَيۡنَا٘ اِلَيۡكَ اَنِ اتَّبِعۡ مِلَّةَ اِبۡرٰهِيۡمَ حَنِيۡفًاؕ وَمَا كَانَ مِنَ الۡمُشۡرِكِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Summma awhainaa ilaika anit tabi' Millata Ibraaheema haneefaa; wa maa kaana minal mushrikeen
ayahs.en: Then We revealed to you, [O Muhammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with Allah.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّمَا جُعِلَ السَّبۡتُ عَلَي الَّذِيۡنَ اخۡتَلَفُوۡا فِيۡهِؕ وَاِنَّ رَبَّكَ لَيَحۡكُمُ بَيۡنَهُمۡ يَوۡمَ الۡقِيٰمَةِ فِيۡمَا كَانُوۡا فِيۡهِ يَخۡتَلِفُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Innnamaa ju'ilas Sabtu 'alal lazeenakhtalafoo feeh; wa inna Rabbaka la yahkumu bainahum Yawmal Qiyaamati feemaa kaanoo feehi yakhtalifoon
ayahs.en: The sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.

ayahs.ar: اُدۡعُ اِلٰي سَبِيۡلِ رَبِّكَ بِالۡحِكۡمَةِ وَالۡمَوۡعِظَةِ الۡحَسَنَةِ وَجَادِلۡهُمۡ بِالَّتِيۡ هِيَ اَحۡسَنُؕ اِنَّ رَبَّكَ هُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِمَنۡ ضَلَّ عَنۡ سَبِيۡلِهٖ وَهُوَ اَعۡلَمُ بِالۡمُهۡتَدِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Ud'u ilaa sabeeli Rabbika bilhikmati walmaw 'izatil hasanati wa jaadilhum billatee hiya ahsan; inna Rabbaka huwa a'almu biman dalla 'an sabeelihee wa Huwa a'lamu bilmuhtadeen
ayahs.en: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good instruction, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided.

ayahs.ar: وَاِنۡ عَاقَبۡتُمۡ فَعَاقِبُوۡا بِمِثۡلِ مَا عُوۡقِبۡتُمۡ بِهٖؕ وَلَئِنۡ صَبَرۡتُمۡ لَهُوَ خَيۡرٌ لِّلصّٰبِرِيۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wa in 'aaqabtum fa'aaqiboo bimisli maa 'ooqibtum bihee wa la'in sabartum lahuwa khairul lissaabireen
ayahs.en: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.

ayahs.ar: وَاصۡبِرۡ وَمَا صَبۡرُكَ اِلَّا بِاللّٰهِ وَلَا تَحۡزَنۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا تَكُ فِيۡ ضَيۡقٍ مِّمَّا يَمۡكُرُوۡنَ
ayahs.tl: Wasbir wa maa sabruka illaa billaah; wa laa tahzan 'alaihim wa laa taku fee daiqim mimmaa yamkuroon
ayahs.en: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through Allah. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.

ayahs.ar: اِنَّ اللّٰهَ مَعَ الَّذِيۡنَ اتَّقَوۡا وَّالَّذِيۡنَ هُمۡ مُّحۡسِنُوۡنَࣖ‏
ayahs.tl: Innal laaha ma'al lazeenat taqaw wal lazeena hum muhsinoon
ayahs.en: Indeed, Allah is with those who fear Him and those who are doers of good.
